project.name: interceptor-bundle-spark-3.5_2.13
project.description:
Produces the single self-contained fat jar that the Python wheel mounts via --jars, for Spark 3.5.x / Scala 2.13.
WHY THIS MODULE EXISTS ---------------------- The pytest plugin mounts exactly ONE jar and sets spark.sql.extensions=io.github.wpunit13.mutator.MutatorSparkExtension Therefore that one jar must contain everything the driver needs: mutator-core (MutantRegistry, hashing, catalog, reports and SessionResetFacade, all reachable over Py4J) interceptor-api (PlanMutatorShim SPI) interceptor-dispatch (ShimDispatcher) interceptor-runtime (MutatorSparkExtension, CatalystMutationRule) interceptor-spark-* (the concrete shim + its META-INF/services entry)
It cannot be produced by interceptor-spark-3.5_2.13 itself, because interceptor-runtime already test-depends on that module; having the shim depend on runtime would create a reactor cycle, which Maven rejects. A separate leaf module breaks the cycle cleanly.
NO PACKAGE RELOCATION --------------------- Relocation is deliberately NOT used, despite the general advice in ARCHITECTURE.md section 5.2. Relocating io.github.wpunit13.mutator.api would rename the PlanMutatorShim interface that ShimImpl implements and that ShimDispatcher loads. Even with ServicesResourceTransformer Even with ServicesResourceTransformer rewriting the service file, the class named in spark.sql.extensions would also have to be the relocated name, which the Python plugin does not know. The net effect would be a runtime "no PlanMutatorShim implementation found" with no other symptom.
Relocation exists to prevent collisions when several shim jars share a classpath. That cannot happen here: the plugin mounts exactly one bundle per session, and distinct shims live in distinct packages (...mutator.spark35, ...mutator.spark34) which do not collide anyway. When a second Spark version is added, give it its own bundle module; do not put two bundles on one classpath.
Verify after building: jar tf target/interceptor-bundle-spark-3.5_2.13-*.jar | grep -E \ "MutatorSparkExtension|MutantRegistry|ShimImpl|META-INF/services" All four must be present, and the services file must be named META-INF/services/io.github.wpunit13.mutator.api.PlanMutatorShim containing the UNRELOCATED implementation class name.
